summary: Added a prefill CUDA-graph capture headroom guard for the reporter-confirmed OOM boundary, retaining only successfully captured replay buckets and failing cleanly if the first bucket cannot start. The Full-backend DFLASH state-index failure remains unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: 13 tests and 7 subtests passed, including stop-after-success at 0.29 GiB, capture at the exact 0.30 GiB boundary, and a clean initial-low-memory failure.
A warmed HIP graph replayed FP32 matrix multiplication on the assigned gfx950 and matched an independently computed CPU reference within rtol=2e-5 and atol=2e-5.
All applicable repository formatting, lint, spelling, syntax, and registered-test registry hooks passed.

gpu_execution_evidence: AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; reports/j-6a298a97f0f9/evidence/gfx950_graph_smoke.junit.xml records the passing HIP graph numerical check.
remaining_limitations: The reported RTX 5090 SM120 / CUDA 13 / PyTorch 2.13 allocator-capture failure cannot be reproduced on the assigned ROCm gfx950 environment.
The RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 target and incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 draft weights were unavailable, so the original full serving command and semantic output were not run.
The Full prefill backend state_indices_list IndexError remains unverified and was not changed without an issue-specific reproduction.
The gfx950 smoke validates HIP graph execution only; it does not qualify NVFP4, the DFLASH model architecture, CUDA allocator behavior, or multi-node execution.
